items.title: JPMorgan starts FedEx Freight at Overweight on post-spin turnaround
items.summary: Investing.com -- In a note to clients on Tuesday, JPMorgan initiated coverage of FedEx Freight with an Overweight rating and a December 2027 price target of $160, arguing the recent spin-off gives North America's largest less-than-truckload carrier room to improve profitability and service as a stand-alone company.

With both the DCF intrinsic value and market multiple checks suggesting the stock leans toward undervalued territory, investors are weighing how much of the recent optimism is already reflected in the price. items.title: FedEx (FDX) Faces New Lawsuit Over Truck Crash Allegations
items.summary: FedEx (NYSE:FDX) is facing a new lawsuit after a major collision in which a company truck driver allegedly fell asleep at the wheel, causing catastrophic injuries to the plaintiff. The complaint claims serious operational failures in FedEx's driver oversight and safety practices that, according to the filing, contributed to the crash.
